text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-san. Do you have some time after 
this today?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"! ...Yes! I-I'm fine! We have time! Lots 
and lots of it!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...??? Well, as long as it worked out, I 
guess...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...Shion-san... was on the phone with 
Onee-san this morning... I couldn't hear 
well, but... Something about a 'birthday 
party'...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...I-it's a surprise for me... I-I have 
to pretend I didn't notice...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(............Wait, this reaction... Don't 
tell me... —Did she figure out the 
surprise!?)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Still, the fact that she didn't mention 
it... means she's being considerate of me, 
I'm sure. In that case, I should—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Um, I won't take up much of your time! 
Would you mind coming with me?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(—I gotta pretend I don't notice that they 
noticed! Can't go making today's birthday 
star feel even more awkward!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... understood. If you're okay... 
with me...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...Knowing Shion-san... She must've 
worked really hard... preparing 
everything...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(A lure... I found a good one.\nI'd be 
happy if they like it—)
